fields.title: Blibli merchant profile / product record
fields.description: Two record shapes, discriminated by `recordType`. MERCHANT_PROFILE carries one flat row per store: identity, seller-performance ratings, shipping origin, audience, review stats and vouchers. PRODUCT carries one row per catalogue item with Blibli's own fields passed through verbatim plus flattened price/rating fields. ERROR carries a diagnostic row when a store fails. Every type is nullable because which fields are populated depends on the record type and on which optional enrichments were enabled.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The store code this record belongs to.

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: S1-merchant-info, S2-catalog-search, or none on failure.

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was scraped.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Present only on failure rows (INVALID_TARGET, STORE_NOT_FOUND, BLOCKED_AFTER_RETRIES, UPSTREAM_SHAPE_CHANGED, INVALID_INPUT, EMPTY_RESULT). STORE_NOT_FOUND means the code returned a hollow profile -- Blibli answers 200 with all-zero ratings for codes that do not exist.

_errorDetail.title: Error detail
_errorDetail.description: Free-form diagnostic detail, present only alongside _error.

isOfficial.title: Official store
isOfficial.description: Whether Blibli marks this as an official brand store.

activationDateIso.title: Store opened
activationDateIso.description: UTC ISO 8601 date the store was activated - how long the competitor has been trading.

badgeRating.title: Badge score
badgeRating.description: Blibli's overall badge score out of 100.

respondTimeRating.title: Response speed rating
respondTimeRating.description: How fast the seller replies to buyers, 0-5. The headline responsiveness figure.

fastCustomerResponseRating.title: Fast response %
fastCustomerResponseRating.description: Percentage of chats answered quickly, over the badge calculation window.

orderCompletedRating.title: Orders completed %
orderCompletedRating.description: Percentage of orders completed rather than cancelled.

perfectTransactionRating.title: Perfect transaction %
perfectTransactionRating.description: Percentage of transactions with no issues.

positiveFeedbackRating.title: Positive feedback %
positiveFeedbackRating.description: Percentage of feedback that is positive.

badgeCalculationDays.title: Badge window (days)
badgeCalculationDays.description: How many days of history the badge scores are calculated over.

pickupPointCode.title: Pickup point code
pickupPointCode.description: Code of the warehouse/pickup point orders ship from.

pickupPointName.title: Pickup point name
pickupPointName.description: Name of the shipping origin, e.g. 'Gudang Blibli'.

pickupPointCity.title: Shipping city
pickupPointCity.description: City goods ship from - drives delivery time and cost to each buyer.

pickupPointAddress.title: Shipping address
pickupPointAddress.description: Full street address of the shipping origin.

fulfilledByBlibli.title: Fulfilled by Blibli
fulfilledByBlibli.description: Whether the store ships from a Blibli-operated warehouse (FBB), which usually means faster delivery.

businessHours.title: Business hours
businessHours.description: Opening and closing time per day of the week at the pickup point.

totalFollowers.title: Followers
totalFollowers.description: How many shoppers follow the store - a direct audience-size measure.

totalReviews.title: Total reviews
totalReviews.description: Public reviews across the store's whole catalogue.

reviewsWithText.title: Reviews with text
reviewsWithText.description: How many of those reviews carry written content.

averageRating.title: Average rating
averageRating.description: Mean star rating across the store's entire review base.

ratingCounts.title: Rating histogram
ratingCounts.description: Review count per star level, keyed '1' to '5'.

negativeSharePercent.title: Negative share %
negativeSharePercent.description: Percentage of rated reviews that are 1-2 star.

reviewTopicCounts.title: Review topic counts
reviewTopicCounts.description: Blibli's own classification of what reviewers discuss: QUALITY, PRICE, SHIPMENT, PACKAGING, SERVICE, ORIGINALITY, GENERIC.

productCount.title: Catalogue size
productCount.description: Total products Blibli reports for the store. Often larger than the number of PRODUCT rows a run can page through - see the 800-per-query limit.

voucherCount.title: Active vouchers
voucherCount.description: How many vouchers the store currently offers.

vouchers.title: Vouchers
vouchers.description: Active vouchers with discount title, minimum spend and expiry - the competitor's promotional posture.

name.title: Name
name.description: Product name on PRODUCT rows; store name on MERCHANT_PROFILE rows.

listPrice.title: List price (IDR)
listPrice.description: PRODUCT rows. Pre-discount price in rupiah.

salePrice.title: Sale price (IDR)
salePrice.description: PRODUCT rows. Current selling price in rupiah.

discountPercent.title: Discount %
discountPercent.description: PRODUCT rows. Discount off list price.

rating.title: Product rating
rating.description: PRODUCT rows. Star rating of the individual product.

reviewCount.title: Product review count
reviewCount.description: PRODUCT rows. Reviews for the individual product.

soldCount.title: Units sold
soldCount.description: PRODUCT rows. Total units sold, where Blibli exposes it - the best available demand proxy.

storeLocation.title: Product ships from
storeLocation.description: PRODUCT rows. Location this specific item ships from.

categories.title: Category hierarchy
categories.description: PRODUCT rows. Category path, useful for mapping which segments a competitor covers.
